problem_text:
A logistics coordinator is tasked with assembling a shipment of specialized equipment to maximize total utility points while adhering to a cargo weight limit.

The available equipment components are:
* Component A: weight 32kg, utility 10 points
* Component B: weight 29kg, utility 90 points
* Component C: weight 16kg, utility 187 points
* Component D: weight 15kg, utility 68 points
* Component E: weight 42kg, utility 34 points
* Component F: weight 25kg, utility 237 points
* Component G: weight 25kg, utility 28 points
* Component H: weight 21kg, utility 23 points
* Component I: weight 44kg, utility 16 points
* Component J: weight 30kg, utility 138 points
* Component K: weight 14kg, utility 100 points
* Component L: weight 30kg, utility 62 points
* Component M: weight 45kg, utility 214 points
* Component N: weight 36kg, utility 38 points
* Component O: weight 17kg, utility 63 points
* Component P: weight 9kg, utility 39 points
* Component Q: weight 1kg, utility 141 points
* Component R: weight 28kg, utility 278 points
* Component S: weight 43kg, utility 155 points
* Component T: weight 5kg, utility 180 points
* Component U: weight 31kg, utility 183 points
* Component V: weight 17kg, utility 181 points
* Component W: weight 15kg, utility 34 points

Furthermore, due to compatibility restrictions, exactly one of Component A and Component B must be included in the shipment.

If Component C is selected, the effective cargo capacity of the transport vehicle is diminished by 10 kg.
The vehicle can accommodate a maximum of 399 kg. The coordinator must determine which components to load.
